Standardized folded YAML case definitions programmatically to preserve syntax integrity.
Added explicit model ID normalization (models/ prefix stripping) and explicit max_tokens parameters for Google and OpenRouter probes.
Maintained total read-only discipline on upstream repositories and verified test suite passing (25/25) offline.
weaknesses: Probe model validation for gemini-3.6-flash depends on upcoming CI execution.
Remote commit SHA insertion is deferred to post-push verification.
